prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for an original CYBERPUNK HUMAN street fighter representing Tensorlake, for the pixel-art website Sandbox Wars. The attached cyan fighter is ONLY a reference for detailed 16-bit pixel rendering and 3x3 sheet format. Make the NEW character distinct, not a palette swap.
CRITICAL: CYBERPUNK CITY COURIER, human wearing a LIZARD-SHAPED TECH RESPIRATOR. NOT a lizard creature, dragon or fantasy adventurer. Entire body human. NO tail, scales on skin, claws, dorsal spines or fantasy armor. Urban techwear, acid-green highlights, grounded street culture.

IDENTITY: stocky adult human woman with dark brown skin, sharp brows, shaved sides and a SHORT acid-green buzzcut stripe on top. Futuristic transparent dark-green respirator covering lower face, elongated angular mouthpiece suggesting a LIZARD SNOUT; black filter vents and tiny green light strip, mechanical angular reptile styling, NOT oni mask or animal head. Small rectangular amber cyberoptic monocle beside eye. Oversized ACID-GREEN technical rain shell with high structured collar, balloon sleeves and asymmetric hem, fitted charcoal shirt beneath; black cross-body courier utility pouch and strap. Slim charcoal trousers with black knee pads and narrow silver reflective ankle strips; heavy charcoal platform street boots with green soles. Black fingerless gloves. Modern waterproof synthetics. No letters, logos or weapons. Anchors: big green jacket, compact human build, tech respirator, short buzzcut, heavy boots.

Square transparent PNG, EXACT nine equal square cells in strict 3-column 3-row grid. At least 7% transparent padding on EVERY side of each cell. Every figure stays wholly in its cell. True alpha, no background, floor, checkerboard, shadows or grid lines. Full-body frames face RIGHT in 3/4 side view, identical anatomical scale, fixed foot baseline 90% down each cell. Body height max 80% of cell. Crisp arcade pixel art, visible square pixel clusters, dark outlines, limited shading ramps, no vector or photo rendering.

TOP TWO ROWS, six CLEAN idle frames: courier slouches with knees slightly bent, one hand hooked into crossbody pouch strap near shoulder and other loosely held low palm open; heavy shoulders, oversized sleeves. Tiny shoulder breathing and jacket movement over six frames. Feet planted, identical head, mask, clothes, anatomy and ground baseline. NOT boxer fists or samurai stance. No tears, bandages or injuries in these frames.

BOTTOM LEFT: battered aftermath, courier sits on ground legs extended in front, back slightly hunched, hands braced behind hips, knees softly bent, green jacket crumpled with small sleeve tear, respirator crooked but still attached, little forehead bandage, eyes exasperated. Ground baseline consistent, entire pose inside cell.

BOTTOM CENTER: tired victory, courier stands slouched and gives one tiny THUMBS-UP at chest height while other hand grips pouch strap, head tipped back slightly, weary eyes, crooked respirator, same torn sleeve and forehead bandage. No raised-fist victory. Same anatomical scale.

BOTTOM RIGHT: enlarged CLEAN head-and-shoulders portrait, prominent futuristic lizard-shaped respirator, dark-brown HUMAN face, short green buzzcut and high green technical collar, no damage or bandage. Clear gutters.

Only this human urban cyberpunk design. No organic reptile body parts. Preserve all nine poses and exact equal-cell layout.
